limitations.note: The registered read fixes the timing bug, but the new address guard makes out-of-range reads return zero instead of the unknown value produced by the original and reference RTL.
The test checked the read timing, but its out-of-range assertion encoded the patch’s own zero-return assumption rather than checking whether the original behavior was preserved.
